description: Make up to 10 faceless videos in one call, each from an idea or an exact script; defaults apply to every item unless it says otherwise. For one video use create_video; for a month of posts, plan_content. Every item is checked before any starts, and the same operation_id on a retry never makes doubles. Each video costs 3 credits to make, plus 1 for each started minute of voice-over and 1 for each started minute of finished video after the first, plus 2 for each extra format; dry_run: true answers the total and starts nothing. Answers with the video ids: follow each with check_video. Cost: About 4 credits per 30-second video (3 credits to make, plus 1 for each started minute of voice-over and 1 for each started minute of finished video after the first, plus 2 for each extra format).
